# SignCut — Apple Shortcuts action catalog

> A human-readable, complete rendering of the **1,791 records in `actions-condensed.json`**,
> extracted from Apple Shortcuts ToolKit on macOS 26.4 (build 25E246).
> This is runtime metadata, **not official authoring documentation** or a guarantee that
> every action will be available on a particular iPhone or correctly serialized as a plist.

Use `actions-condensed.json` as the machine-readable primary reference; this catalog is for browsing.
For information not carried into either rendering, inspect `toolkit-raw.db` (SQLite).

## Coverage

- Classic actions: **382**
- Siri intents: **87**
- App intents: **1,322**
- Total: **1,791**

Entries are grouped by integration type, then sorted by display name. Use your editor’s search to find a keyword or identifier.

### Calculate

    - `x^3` → x^3
    - `x^y` → x^y
    - `e^x` → e^x
    - `10^x` → 10^x
    - `ln(x)` → ln(x)
    - `log(x)` → log(x)
    - `√x` → √x
    - `∛x` → ∛x
    - `x!` → x!
    - `sin(x)` → sin(x)
    - `cos(x)` → cos(x)
    - `tan(x)` → tan(x)
    - `abs(x)` → abs(x)

- `WFScientificMathOperand` — **Operand**

**Output types:** `number`

**Output name:** Calculation Result

### Convert Image

**Identifier:** `is.workflow.actions.image.convert`  
**Type:** `action`

Converts the images passed into the action to the specified image format.

**Parameters:**

- `WFImageFormat` — **Format** (`Format`)
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `JPEG` → JPEG
    - `PNG` → PNG
    - `TIFF` → TIFF
    - `GIF` → GIF
    - `BMP` → BMP
    - `PDF` → PDF
    - `HEIF` → HEIF
    - `Match Input` → Match Input
- `WFImageCompressionQuality` — **Quality**
  - Allows you to choose the image quality used when compressing the image file. Higher quality images will look better, but result in larger files.
- `WFImagePreserveMetadata` — **Preserve Metadata** (`Boolean`)
  - When Preserve Metadata is turned off, all metadata, such as the GPS coordinates where the photo was taken, will be stripped from the image file.
- `WFInput` — **Image** (`Anything`)

**Output types:** `file`

**Output name:** Converted Image

### Find Music

**Identifier:** `is.workflow.actions.filter.music`  
**Type:** `action`

Searches for the music in your library that match the given criteria.

**Parameters:**

- `WFContentItemFilter`
- `WFContentItemSortProperty` — **Sort by** (`Sort by`)
  - Optionally, what to sort the music by.
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `Title` → Title
    - `Album` → Album
    - `Artist` → Artist
    - `Album Artist` → Album Artist
    - `Genre` → Genre
    - `Composer` → Composer
    - `Date Added` → Date Added
    - `Media Kind` → Media Kind
    - `Duration` → Duration
    - `Play Count` → Play Count
    - `Album Track #` → Track Number
    - `Disc #` → Disc Number
    - `Release Date` → Release Date
    - `Skip Count` → Skip Count
    - `Last Played Date` → Last Played Date
    - `Rating` → Rating
    - `File Path` → File Path
    - `Name` → Name
    - `Random` → Random
- `WFContentItemSortOrder` — **Order**
  - The order to sort the music in.
- `WFContentItemLimitEnabled` — **Limit** (`Boolean`)
  - Whether or not to limit the number of music retrieved.
- `WFContentItemLimitNumber` — **Get**
  - The maximum number of music.
- `WFCompoundType`
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `0` → Any
    - `1` → All
- `WFContentItemInputParameter` — **music** (`music`)
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `Library` → Music

**Output types:** `file`

**Output name:** Music

### New Reminder

**Identifier:** `is.workflow.actions.addnewreminder`  
**Type:** `action`

Creates a new reminder and adds it to the selected list of reminders.

**Parameters:**

- `WFCalendarItemTitle` — **Reminder**
  - The title of this reminder.
- `WFCalendarDescriptor` — **List** (`Calendar`)
  - The list of reminders to add this reminder to.
- `WFAlertEnabled` — **Alert** (`Alert`)
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `No Alert` → No Alert
    - `Alert` → Alert
- `WFAlertCondition` — **Trigger** (`Trigger`)
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `At Time` → At Time
    - `When I Arrive` → When I Arrive
    - `When I Leave` → When I Leave
    - `When Messaging` → When Messaging
- `WFAlertLocation` — **Location**
  - The location that triggers the alert.
- `WFAlertPerson` — **Person**
  - The reminder notification will be shown when chatting with this person in Messages.
- `WFAlertLocationRadius` — **Radius**
  - The distance from the provided location to consider "arriving" or "leaving" the location
- `WFAlertCustomTime` — **Time**
  - Text representing the date or date and time when the alert should occur. Examples: “tonight at 7”, “March 7”
- `WFPriority` — **Priority** (`Priority`)
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `None` → None
    - `Low` → Low
    - `Medium` → Medium
    - `High` → High
- `WFUrgent` — **Urgent** (`Boolean`)
- `WFFlag` — **Flag** (`Boolean`)
- `WFURL` — **URL**
  - Optionally, a URL to attach to this reminder.
- `WFImages` — **Images** (`Anything`)
  - An optional set of images to attach to this reminder. Use a variable to get the images.
- `WFParentTask` — **Parent Reminder** (`Anything`)
  - Optionally, a parent reminder to add this reminder to.
- `WFCalendarItemNotes` — **Notes**
  - Optionally, a description for this reminder.

**Output types:** `com.apple.shortcuts.WFReminderContentItem`

**Output name:** New Reminder

### Open X-Callback URL

**Output types:** `string`, `file`

### Overlay Text

**Identifier:** `is.workflow.actions.overlaytext`  
**Type:** `action`

Overlays text onto the image passed as input.

**Parameters:**

- `WFText` — **Text**
- `WFImage` — **Image** (`Anything`)
- `WFTextPosition` — **Position** (`Position`)
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `Top Left` → Top Left
    - `Top Center` → Top Center
    - `Top Right` → Top Right
    - `Middle Left` → Middle Left
    - `Center` → Center
    - `Middle Right` → Middle Right
    - `Bottom Left` → Bottom Left
    - `Bottom Center` → Bottom Center
    - `Bottom Right` → Bottom Right
    - `Custom Position` → Custom Position
- `WFTextX` — **X Coordinate**
  - The X Coordinate to start the text at, in points. 0 starts at the left of the image.
- `WFPercentageTextX` — **X Coordinate**
  - The X Coordinate to start the text at, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. 0 starts at the left of the image.
- `WFTextY` — **Y Coordinate**
  - The Y Coordinate to start the text at, in points. 0 starts at the top of the image.
- `WFPercentageTextY` — **Y Coordinate**
  - The Y Coordinate to start the text at, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. 0 starts at the top of the image.
- `WFTextOffset` — **Offset**
  - The amount of additional space between the text box and the nearest edges of the image, in points. For example, the nearest edges are the Left for Middle Left alignment, the Bottom and Right for Bottom Right alignment, and the Top for Top alignment.
- `WFPercentageTextOffset` — **Offset**
  - The amount of additional space between the text box and the nearest edges of the image, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. For example, the nearest edges are the Left for Middle Left alignment, the Bottom and Right for Bottom Right alignment, and the Top for Top alignment.
- `WFFontSize` — **Font Size**
  - The size of the font, in points, to apply to the text.
- `WFPercentageFontSize` — **Font Size**
  - The size of the font, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1, to apply to the text.
- `WFTextAlignment` — **Text Alignment** (`Text Alignment`)
  - The alignment to apply to the text. This will align to the edge of the bounding box created by the Maximum Width, if any.
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `Left` → Left
    - `Center` → Center
    - `Right` → Right
- `WFTextColor` — **Font Color**
- `WFTextRotation` — **Rotation**
  - The amount of rotation, in degrees, to apply to the text. Starts from the center of the text bounds. Optional.
- `WFTextOutlineEnabled` — **Outline Text** (`Boolean`)
- `WFTextStrokeWidth` — **Stroke Width**
  - The stroke width, in points, to apply to the text. Optional.
- `WFPercentageTextStrokeWidth` — **Stroke Width**
  - The stroke width, as a decimal proportion of the font size between 0 and 1, to apply to the text. Optional.
- `WFTextStrokeColor` — **Stroke Color**
- `WFTextBoxWidth` — **Maximum Width**
  - The maximum width of the text, in points. If 0, the text will have a bounding box that is as wide as necessary, and may run off the edge of the image. Otherwise, the text will wrap within the bounds of the width. Optional.
- `WFPercentageTextBoxWidth` — **Maximum Width**
  - The maximum width of the text, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. If 0, the text will have a bounding box that is as wide as necessary, and may run off the edge of the image. Otherwise, the text will wrap within the bounds of the width. Optional.
- `WFSizingMethod` — **Sizing** (`Sizing`)
  - The sizing method to use. Proportional sizing will cause all parameters to use a decimal proportion between 0 and 1. Absolute sizing will cause all parameters to use points.
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `Proportional` → Proportional
    - `Absolute` → Absolute

**Output types:** `file`

**Output name:** Image with Text

### Stop and Output

**Identifier:** `is.workflow.actions.output`  
**Type:** `action`

Stops execution of the current shortcut, and outputs content. This action is useful when: • Running a shortcut from another shortcut (using the Run Shortcut action). The output will be used as the output of the Run Shortcut action. • Running a shortcut from Quick Actions in Finder on macOS. The output will be saved as a file alongside the files selected in Finder. • Running a shortcut from Services on macOS. The output will replace the selected text, if applicable. • Or, when running a shortcut from another location that supports output, like the command-line or the Shortcuts URL scheme.  No more actions will be run after this action.

**Parameters:**

- `WFOutput` — **Result**
- `WFNoOutputSurfaceBehavior` — **If there’s nowhere to output** (`If there’s nowhere to output`)
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `Respond` → Respond
    - `Do Nothing` → Do Nothing
    - `Copy to Clipboard` → Copy to Clipboard
- `WFResponse` — **Result**

**Output types:** `string`

### Use Model

**Identifier:** `is.workflow.actions.askllm`  
**Type:** `action`

Use a model to handle complex requests in your shortcuts.

**Parameters:**

- `WFLLMPrompt` — **Request**
  - A request for the model that optionally includes variables and outputs from previous actions, including calendar events, reminders, images, and more.
- `WFLLMModel` — **Model** (`WFAskLLMModelParameter`)
- `FollowUp` — **Follow Up** (`Boolean`)
  - Show the model’s response and make additional requests before the final response is passed to the next action.
- `WFGenerativeResultType` — **Output**
  - Responses are automatically optimized for the actions they're passed into — for example, if the response is passed into the 'Repeat with Each' action, the model creates a list.  To manually specify the model's output, select an output type using the 'Output' parameter.  **Private Cloud Compute Model** Use a large server-based model on Private Cloud Compute to handle complex requests while protecting your privacy.  **On-Device Model** Use the on-device model to handle simple requests without the need for a network connection.  Image analysis is supported by the Private Cloud Compute model.

**Output types:** `com.apple.shortcuts.GeneratedContent`, `date`, `number`, `file`, `com.apple.shortcuts.WFContentItem`, `bool`

**Output name:** Response

### Get Physical Activity

**Identifier:** `com.apple.ShortcutsActions.GetPhysicalActivity`  
**Type:** `appIntent`

Returns a Physical Activity that describes your apparent movement (for example, Stationary, Running, or In a Moving Vehicle). On iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, the system uses the device’s sensors to determine your physical activity.  A result of “Moving” indicates that the motion doesn’t seem to fit a known pattern. You may observe higher accuracy by adjusting the device’s placement.  A result of “Unknown” indicates that the device is not supported.

**Output types:** `com.apple.ShortcutsActions.PhysicalActivity`

**Output name:** Physical Activity

**Identifier:** `com.apple.omniSearch.SearchToolExtension.SearchTool`

Answer user's query

  - The raw user query with no additional rewrite.
- `rewrittenQuery` — **rewrittenQuery**
  - The query potentially rewritten by another component.
- `simplifiedQuery` — **simplifiedQuery**
  - The query potentially rewritten into a simplified form, used for spotlight text embedding search.
- `structuredQuery` — **structuredQueryEntity** (`StructuredQueryEntity`)
  - Structured query input used to directly drive the search.
- `typeIdentifiers` — **typeIdentifiers** (`Search Entity Type Identifier`)
  - A set of type identifiers used to constrain the search.
- `context` — **context** (`Search Context`)
  - Request, session, and environmental context
- `matchedEntities` — **entities** (`Entity Match`)
  - Entity span matches
- `isFirstToolInvocation` — **isFirstToolInvocation** (`Boolean`)
  - Whether this search is the first tool call for the turn
- `isOnScreenReference` — **isOnScreenReference** (`Boolean`)
  - Whether search should only use information available on screen to answer the query
- `isSingleStepSearch` — **isSingleStepSearch** (`Boolean`)
  - Whether this search is part of a single step plan, or part of a multi-step (search composite) plan
- `invocationClient` — **invocationClient** (`Search Tool Client Type`)
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `montaraWritingTool` → Montara Writing Tool
- `requestedProperties` — **requestedProperties** (`SearchPropertyRequest`)
- `disambiguatedEntity` — **disambiguatedEntity** (`Search Entity`)

- `highlightedPropertyType` — **Highlighted Property Type** (`A highlighted value from the displayed contact`)
  - The property type to highlight
  - Available enum cases (value → title):
    - `phoneNumber` → phone number
    - `emailAddress` → email address
    - `postalAddress` → postal address
    - `birthday` → birthday
    - `contactRelation` → contact relation
    - `note` → note
    - `custom` → custom
- `shouldEdit` — **Should open for editing** (`Boolean`)
  - Should the card open for editing?

**Output types:** `none`
